question: A and B are brothers. P and Q are a married couple. Q is the sister of A. How is B related to P?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/787e52a1ad546ea4085b253573647acdf71f9028dc2f1a569f19eb8803e44bc1.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9f98e08552a2bad752a18df50d044331482c4720f69816d3178ad5f59904c29f.png]

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2"**.
